description_excerpt: Job Description Takes lead of the testing activities of the technicians in compliance to ISO 17025. Performs training of new technicians as well as training of technicians whenever there's an update in the test procedures. Monitors the testing deadlines/due dates as specified in the test request. Performs regular checking of test results provided by the technicians. Develops new test procedures, techniques and equipment whenever necessary.
